items.title: Why analysts say a diesel export ban could backfire
items.content: A ban on U.S. diesel exports could reduce supplies and simultaneously lead to prices rising further, according to analysts.

items.title: Here are the hidden flaws in Warsh’s new way of tracking inflation
items.content: Economists at Nomura say the new way Kevin Warsh is tracking inflation doesn’t have better predictive power than core readings.

items.title: My friend grosses $300,000 a year with her pet-sitting business. She pays herself $50,000. Should I do the same?
items.content: “She currently has about 15 sitters, all independent contractors.”

items.title: The real estate portfolio of Zendaya and Tom Holland, plus her plans for a room just for her wedding dress
items.content: Tom Holland and Zendaya are reportedly planning to install a climate-controlled room in one of their several properties to preserve her $269,000 wedding gown.

items.title: TV host Maria Menounos lists a beautifully renovated Encino mansion for $7 million
items.content: TV personality Maria Menounos has listed her longtime Encino mansion for $6.995 million, two decades after she and husband made the sprawling California estate their home.

items.title: Softbank’s mega junk-bond deal shows capital for the AI race is getting more expensive
items.content: The artificial intelligence build-out is officially crossing over to the world of junk bonds, where investors expect to be paid more for taking bigger risks.

items.title: This oil giant has lagged its leading rivals through two energy crises. Now one Wall Street giant says it’s time to buy.
items.content: Integrated oil giant BP has lagged its closest rivals over the last three to five years, but now one leading Wall Street firm says it’s time to buy the beleaguered company.

items.title: ‘It doesn’t seem fair’: I’m retired and have plenty of money. Why can’t I qualify for a retail credit card?
items.content: “I draw from my IRA as needed for household repairs, trips and other larger expenses.”

items.title: ‘She gave a neighbor $2,000’: Social Security overpaid my mother, 82, by $20,000. What else is hiding in her finances?
items.content: “My mother has a pension, Social Security, investments and a house probably worth over $1 million.”

items.title: The Nasdaq’s rapid rise to a record is sending a message to investors: Don’t wait for a pullback to buy
items.content: Some analysts say the upbeat data on the Nasdaq’s outlook is backed up by improving fundamentals.
